    Collect filenames that are associated with a NONMEM run

    getFileNames.Rd

    Assembles the model, ext, phi and lst file names for a run based on either run number or model name (the part of the file name to the left of the filename extension).

    Usage

    getFileNames(
  runno = NULL,
  modName = NULL,
  modDevDir = ".",
  modExt = ".mod",
  lstExt = ".lst"
)

    Arguments

    runno

    The run number. Must be provided if modName is NULL. Will be used to create NONMEM model and results file names with the structure run#.mod and run#. NONMEM ext, phi and cov files will be assumed to be named run# followed by the appropriate suffix (where # is runno).

    modName

    The model name. Will be used together with modExt, lstExt, ext, phi and cov to form the NONMEM file names, for example modName.mod for the model file.

    modDevDir

    The directory where the files reside. Default is the current directory, i.e. ".".

    modExt

    The model file name extension. Default is ".mod".

    lstExt

    The NONMEM out file name extension. Default is ".lst".

    Value

    A list with components "mod", "ext", "phi" and "lst" specifying the path names of the corresponding files.

    Details

    runno and modName can not both be NULL. If both are provided, modName is used.

    modDevDir can not be NULL.

    See also

    Other NONMEM Parsers: getCovNames(), getExt(), getPhi()

    Examples

    getFileNames(runno = 30, modDevDir = system.file("extdata/SimNeb/", package = "PMXFrem"))
#> $mod
#> [1] "/home/github/runner/_work/_temp/Rlib-32344486548/PMXFrem/extdata/SimNeb//run30.mod"
#> 
#> $ext
#> [1] "/home/github/runner/_work/_temp/Rlib-32344486548/PMXFrem/extdata/SimNeb//run30.ext"
#> 
#> $phi
#> [1] "/home/github/runner/_work/_temp/Rlib-32344486548/PMXFrem/extdata/SimNeb//run30.phi"
#> 
#> $lst
#> [1] "/home/github/runner/_work/_temp/Rlib-32344486548/PMXFrem/extdata/SimNeb//run30.lst"
#> 
#> $cov
#> [1] "/home/github/runner/_work/_temp/Rlib-32344486548/PMXFrem/extdata/SimNeb//run30.cov"
#>
